children: Madera Ventures LLC disclosed a 7.36% stake in TriplePoint Venture Growth BDC Corp. through direct and indirect holdings. The Schedule 13D was filed on Sep. 22, 2026, following a series of open-market buys and a private share purchase completed on Sep. 18, 2026. The move consolidates control across the TriplePoint group and lifts Madera’s influence at the business development company.

Madera reports the position for investment purposes, stating that “TPC acquired the reported securities for investment purposes.” The group executed a discretionary share purchase plan announced on Aug. 6, 2025 “to acquire up to $14 million” of TriplePoint Venture Growth BDC Corp.’s stock, and it carried out multiple open‑market purchases.

On Sep. 18, 2026, TriplePoint Capital LLC bought 313,865.22 shares from Sajal K. Srivastava in a private deal after he notified plans to resign his executive roles by year‑end. The purchase increased TriplePoint Capital LLC’s direct ownership to 5.68% and raised Madera’s aggregate beneficial stake to 7.36%.

Madera Ventures LLC is a Delaware limited liability company that acquires and manages a controlling equity stake in TriplePoint Capital Holdings LLC. Through the TriplePoint platform, the group focuses on venture lending and selective equity investments in technology and other high‑growth sectors. TriplePoint Advisers LLC, an affiliate, serves as investment adviser to TriplePoint Venture Growth BDC Corp.
